reviews_verbatim.author: Sam Issa
reviews_verbatim.text: Jorge and his team did a complete renovation job to my house, including plumbing, electrical, flooring, bathrooms, kitchen, paint and final touches on every thing. The house turned out great, and got good comments from everyone who saw it. It didn't take long to find a buyer for it.

reviews_verbatim.text: We recently completed a full remodel with Magic Hands, and the experience was outstanding. Jorge brought great ideas, stayed solution-oriented throughout the project, and maintained open, honest communication from start to finish.
